dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Look! That's the Dragon-Queller. We've been here before — this place is as intriguing as ever...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Let's try playing the Ancient Zither here, {NICKNAME}!
